# CL Growth Academy

> CL Growth Academy is a founder-led growth practice run by Chris Lapa, NSW-based, working with providers Australia-wide. It helps NDIS and aged care providers get found and get chosen: marketing channels to bring in enquiries, plus referral partnerships and enquiry handling so those enquiries turn into clients.

Contact: chris@thegrowthacademy.com.au, +61 431 584 725

## Services

- [How we help](https://thegrowthacademy.com.au/how-we-help.html): the four-step process (audit, strategy, execution, reporting) and the ways to work together: done for you, done with you coaching, one-off workshops and Managed Growth
- [NDIS marketing hub](https://thegrowthacademy.com.au/ndis-marketing/): how the ten services work together across getting found and getting chosen
- [Managed Growth](https://thegrowthacademy.com.au/ndis-marketing/managed.html): every channel run as one plan by a senior growth strategist, monthly retainer, quarterly strategy reviews
- [NDIS SEO](https://thegrowthacademy.com.au/ndis-marketing/seo.html): local search, Google Business Profile, content and AI search visibility
- [NDIS Google Ads](https://thegrowthacademy.com.au/ndis-marketing/ads.html): search campaigns, landing pages, call and form tracking
- [NDIS social media ads](https://thegrowthacademy.com.au/ndis-marketing/social-ads.html): Meta campaigns, creative and retargeting
- [Email marketing](https://thegrowthacademy.com.au/ndis-marketing/email.html): enquiry sequences, referrer nurture and newsletters
- [Social and content](https://thegrowthacademy.com.au/ndis-marketing/social.html): content calendar, platform strategy and posting
- [NDIS LinkedIn](https://thegrowthacademy.com.au/ndis-marketing/linkedin.html): profile building for owners and staff, plus a posting and outreach routine for support coordinators and referrers
- [Referrals and partnerships](https://thegrowthacademy.com.au/ndis-marketing/referrals.html): support coordinator, allied health and hospital discharge relationships, and referral tracking
- [Sales and enquiry process](https://thegrowthacademy.com.au/ndis-marketing/sales-process.html): response time, intake conversations, follow-up and team coaching
- [Aged care marketing](https://thegrowthacademy.com.au/aged-care-marketing.html): marketing for Support at Home and residential aged care providers: Google Ads, SEO, referrals and enquiry handling under the new Aged Care Act

## Articles

- [NDIS digital marketing strategy](https://thegrowthacademy.com.au/blog/ndis-digital-marketing-strategy.html)
- [Attract NDIS participants with Google Ads](https://thegrowthacademy.com.au/blog/attract-ndis-participants-with-google-ads.html)
- [How can SEO grow my business?](https://thegrowthacademy.com.au/blog/how-can-seo-grow-my-business.html)
- [How can you use marketing for business growth?](https://thegrowthacademy.com.au/blog/marketing-for-business-growth.html)
- [Social media for NDIS providers](https://thegrowthacademy.com.au/blog/grow-your-business-through-social-media.html): which platforms reach families and which reach support coordinators, what to post, consent and NDIS logo rules, and how to measure referrals
- [Virtual assistants for NDIS providers](https://thegrowthacademy.com.au/blog/grow-your-business-with-virtual-assistants.html): which tasks to hand a VA and which to keep, how to protect participant data, and how to measure it
- [Virtual assistant vs AI for NDIS providers](https://thegrowthacademy.com.au/blog/virtual-assistant-vs-ai.html): a task-by-task look at what a VA and AI each do well, what they cost, and when you need both
- [How to grow an NDIS business: 6 key areas](https://thegrowthacademy.com.au/blog/key-areas-for-business-growth.html): referrers, intake, participant and staff retention, capacity and owner time, with a number to watch for each
- [Founder issues holding back NDIS business growth](https://thegrowthacademy.com.au/blog/founder-issues-impacting-your-business-growth.html): signs the owner has become the bottleneck, which jobs to hand over first, and how to step back without losing referrers
